items.title: GSoC Week 8: Closing the sin(x^2)cos(x) Gap
items.content_text: Last week ended with a problem I couldn't solve: manualintegrate had no way to handle $\int x^2 \sin(x^2)\cos(x)\,dx$, even though Wolfram Alpha resolves it in a few standard steps. This week I went back and built the two rules that close that gap, and in the process learned that fixing one class of integral just moves the wall a little further out.
